title: Cambridgeshire train stabbings: ‘heroic’ rail staff member fighting for life after tackling attacker
summary: British Transport Police say LNER worker ‘undoubtedly saved lives’ as suspect remains in custody A “heroic” rail staff member who intervened in a mass stabbing to save the lives of high-speed train passengers suffered life-threatening injuries, police said on Sunday, as a suspect remains in custody. The member of LNER staff was recorded on CCTV attempting to stop the attacker as the train travelled between Peterborough and Huntingdon in Cambridgeshire, British Transport Police said.
